Location: New Plymouth, Taranaki

Are you an experienced leader in the water, civil, utilities, or construction sector looking for your next challenge?

The Role

You'll provide leadership and support to field staff, assist with planning and scheduling, manage productivity, and play a key role in maintaining strong client relationships.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading and supporting field-based operational teams
  • Coordinating labour, plant, and resources across multiple work sites
  • Coaching, mentoring, and developing staff
  • Monitoring productivity, quality, and contract performance
  • Supporting planning, scheduling, and workload management
  • Promoting a strong health and safety culture
  • Building positive relationships with clients, contractors, and stakeholders

About You

We're keen to hear from candidates who have leadership or supervisory experience within water infrastructure, civil construction, utilities, drainage, roading, or other related industries.

You may currently be a:

  • Team Leader
  • Foreperson
  • Leading Hand

  • Operations Supervisor
To be successful, you'll ideally have:

  • Experience leading field teams in a construction, civil, utilities, or infrastructure environment
  • Strong communication and people management skills

Highly regarded:

  • Connexis Utilities Maintenance certification.

Apply Now

job.title: Electrical Site Supervisor
job.description:
Electrical Site Supervisor - Solar Projects

Location: Masterton, New Zealand

We're seeking an experienced Electrical Site Supervisor to oversee the safe, compliant, and efficient installation of electrical works on a large-scale solar PV and battery energy storage project based in Masterton. This is a hands-on leadership role suited to someone who enjoys being on site, leading crews, and ensuring projects are delivered to the highest standards of safety, quality, and performance.

About the Role

Based in Masterton, you'll take the lead in coordinating day-to-day electrical construction activities on a major renewable energy project. You'll be responsible for supervising electrical personnel, managing subcontractors, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and project requirements, and acting as the key on-site contact for clients, contractors, and project stakeholders.

This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in the delivery of critical energy infrastructure while working as part of a highly experienced project team.

This position is field-based and may involve travel between project sites nationwide.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate electrical crews, subcontractors, apprentices, and labour-hire personnel
  • Drive a strong safety culture through toolbox talks, hazard management, and compliance monitoring
  • Oversee LV electrical installations, testing, commissioning, and certification
  • Manage isolations, switching activities, and safe work procedures
  • Review and approve site documentation, daily reports, timesheets, and testing records
  • Liaise with clients, inspectors, network operators, engineers, and project management teams
  • Monitor programme delivery, productivity, quality, and resource requirements
  • Support tendering and pre-construction activities by providing practical construction input and risk assessments
What We're Looking For

  • Current EWRB Electrician Registration and Practising Licence
  • Mains Parallel Generation Systems endorsement
  • Supervision endorsement
  • Strong experience supervising electrical teams on commercial, industrial, infrastructure, solar, or renewable energy projects
  • Excellent knowledge of NZ electrical regulations, standards, and safe work practices
  • Strong leadership, planning, and communication skills
  • Current First Aid and CPR certification
  • Site Safe Passport or equivalent
Highly desirable:

  • Solar PV and battery storage project experience
  • EWP, Working at Heights, Telehandler, or other plant operating certifications
What's On Offer

  • Opportunity to work on some of New Zealand's growing solar projects
  • A leadership role with genuine ownership and responsibility
  • Supportive and collaborative project team environment
Apply Now

If you're an experienced Electrical Supervisor looking to play a key role in New Zealand's renewable energy sector, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today with your CV or get in touch for a confidential discussion victoriae@tech5.co.nz
